changelog:
- Initial release of the Chinese Business Email Generator skill.
- Quickly generates clear, formal, and professional Chinese business emails based on user-provided key points.
- Supports multiple business scenarios, such as client communication, internal notifications, meeting invitations, project updates, and complaint resolution.
- Recognizes diverse trigger expressions like “商务邮件”, “工作邮件”, “商务函件”, “email写作”, and “邮件撰写”.
- Aims to help professionals save time and enhance the quality and professionalism of their written communications.
summary: 根据用户提供的核心要点，快速生成结构清晰、语气正式得体的中文商务邮件。适用于 对外合作洽谈、客户沟通、内部通知、会议邀约、项目跟进、投诉处理等多种职场场景。 支持"商务邮件/工作邮件/商务函件/email写作/邮件撰写"等多种表达方式触发，帮助 职场人士节省写作时间，提升书面沟通的专业形象与表达质量。
